name: Pasahero [ANOMALY HORROR]
desc:
⚠️ Pasahero is still in heavy development, so you may run into some bugs. Thanks for riding with us, and tell us anything strange you find!

PASAHERO: A Filipino folklore horror game 🌙

Drive a tricycle down a lonely road at night, pick up passengers, and get home to Lola before sunrise. But not every passenger is human.

Play solo or with up to 4 friends. Find every ending, then try Endless mode.

Ingat sa daan. 🎧 Headphones recommended.

llm.loop: drive a tricycle on a night road -> pick up passengers -> spot anomalies / non-human passengers -> survive to reach Lola by sunrise -> endings, endless mode
llm.objectives: get home before sunrise and find every ending
llm.instructions: Drive, pick up passengers, beware not all are human; solo or up to 4
unique: Filipino folklore (White Lady, manananggal) tricycle horror
llm.thumbnails: dark first-person tricycle with White Lady ahead, winged creature
